name: spellchecker-engine
description: POC demo of the SMS Content Validation Engine (per SMS_CONTENT_VALIDATION_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md). Local-first, deterministic rules + small statistical context model. No external AI/API.

scripts.test:python: uv run python -m unittest discover -s test -t . -v
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:python
scripts.data:audit: uv run python -m unittest test.test_spelling_dataset_split test.test_clean_source_split test.test_split_grouping test.test_benchmark_artifact_scope -v && node --test test/test_benchmark_scope.mjs
